We were supposed to ride the exhibition in Rohozná before Covid, but unfortunately you can't control an epidemic and the event was postponed several times. Before the exhibition itself we visited the Trial park in Hamry nad Sázavou, where we did a light training session that within an hour turned into cold, cloudy, windy weather. We'd given it our all, so there was no point risking injury and we set off for Rohozná.

This village of 300–400 inhabitants evidently knows how to have fun, and they'd prepared a pretty nice programme with the facilities of the local football club, which was playing its match when we arrived.

When we arrived the weather still looked good, but unfortunately the tradition of the last 3 weeks repeated itself, and Vlasta and Lukáš Valný with little Marty Kabeláč waited in the car for the rain to stop. After an hour it was clear it wasn't going to pass, and the spectators wanted to be entertained. And since the guys were the highlight of the programme, there was nothing left but to pluck up courage and try to show some Trial art even in the rain. Luckily it all went without a big crash, even though the grass and our obstacles were slippery as ice. 

The spectators were great and praised the whole team for both the performance and the attitude. We look forward to Rohozná again in 2023.
